name: Fill #9999 · INTU BUY
description:
A filled stop order ticket for Intuit (INTU) on Robinhood Chain, settled in ETH during regular hours. Held in a wallet linked to Suwappu, this ticket runs a Desk desk: −10 bps on swap fees and +5% XP on INTU swaps.

Tokenized-equity ticket. Collectible only. Not equity, not a security, no shareholder or voting rights, no claim on any issuer or on the referenced ERC-20.
